questions.question: The International Kite and Sweet Festival as part of the Sankranti celebrations was organized in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Telangana__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Telangana Tourism Minister J Krishna Rao and Transport Minister P Prabhakar inaugurated the International Kite and Sweet Festival.
 
• The festival is being held at Parade Grounds in Telangana as part of the Sankranti celebrations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Telangana State Tourism and Culture Department organized the festival to celebrate cultural heritage and culinary diversity.
 
• The event includes 57 international kite flyers from 19 countries and 58 national kite flyers from 22 Indian states.
 
• Traditional performances include Perini, Shiva Tandavam, Bharatanatyam, and Kuchipudi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Over 1,300 stalls showcase a variety of food and sweets from India and abroad.
 
• Handloom displays and tribal dances are also major attractions.

questions.question: Which state organizes the world's largest open air theater Dhanu Yatra festival?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Odisha.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• ‘Dhanu Yatra’ began after a gap of two years in Bargarh, Odisha.
 
• It is an annual drama-based open-air theatrical performance celebrated in Odisha.
 
• It is considered the largest open-air theatre in the world.
 
• Spread over five square km, the entire town of Bargarh turns into a stage for the yatra.
 
• The ‘Dhanu Yatra’ which marks the victory of good over evil, came into existence in Bargarh in 1947-48 and is held annually.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• The Festival is being held from December 27 to Jan 6, 2023.
 
• Around 3,000 artists from 130 cultural troupes from across the country are participating in the festival.
 
• However, Kansa is the central attraction of the Dhanu Yatra.
 
• 
 
Dhanu yatra was held last time from December 31, 2019, to January 10, 2020.

questions.question: Which of the following tribes does NOT live in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maasai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maasai** is a tribe that predominantly lives in **Kenya and Tanzania**.
 
• They are known for their distinct culture, customs, and dress.
 
• Unlike the other tribes listed in the question (Gond, Santhal, Tharu), the Maasai do not have a presence in India.
 
• The Maasai people are semi-nomadic and are known for their traditional lifestyle and resistance to modern cultural influences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gond** is one of the largest tribal groups in India, found mainly in **Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra, Odisha, and Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• **Santhal** is a prominent tribe in India, primarily residing in **Jharkhand, West Bengal, Bihar, and Odisha**.
 
• **Tharu** is a tribal community living in the Terai region of **Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar **in India.
 
• These tribes (Gond, Santhal, Tharu) contribute to India's rich cultural and ethnic diversity.

questions.question:
​Consider the following statements regarding the Maha Kumbh Mela:

1. The Kumbh Mela, including the Maha Kumbh, is recognized by UNESCO as part of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

2. The Maha Kumbh area is a separate district.

3. The Maha Kumbh Mela is held every six years in Prayagraj.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The** Uttar Pradesh government** has declared the **Maha Kumbh area a temporary district **to ensure smooth management of the 2025 Maha Kumbh Mela.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• ​​UNESCO Recognition: The Kumbh Mela, including the Maha Kumbh, was inscribed in UNESCO’s Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2017. *Hence, Statement 1 is correct.*
 
• Separate District: The Maha Kumbh area has been declared a separate district for administrative purposes ahead of the 2025 event. *Hence, Statement 2 is correct.*
 
• Frequency of Maha Kumbh: The Maha Kumbh occurs once every 12 years, not six years. *Hence, Statement 3 is incorrect.*
 
• UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: The Kumbh Mela was recognized for its cultural significance, representing the confluence of diverse traditions and practices in India.
 
• 2025 Maha Kumbh: Scheduled from January 13 to February 26, 2025, it is expected to draw over 400 million devotees.
 
• Eco-Friendly Initiatives: For the first time, the event will feature e-vehicle services and luxury tent accommodations to improve visitor experience. 

74

questions.question: Which festival is celebrated by Christians as the birth of Jesus Christ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Christmas**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Christmas** is celebrated by Christians around the world as the birth of Jesus Christ.
 
• This festival is observed on **December 25th** each year.
 
• Christmas is marked by various traditions including gift-giving, decorating Christmas trees, attending church services, and sharing meals with family and friends<

questions.question: In which Indian state is the 'International Lusophone Festival' hosted?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The International Lusophone Festival will be held in Goa from 3-6 December.
 
• It will be inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Goa, Pramod Sawant in Raj Bhavan.
 
• It is organized by the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) in partnership with the Indian Council of Cultural Relations (ICCR) and the Goa govt.
 
• Lusophones are people that speak Portuguese as a native or as a common second language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The Ministry of External Affairs of India is the government agency responsible for implementing Indian foreign policy.
 
• Subrahmanyam Jaishankar is an Indian diplomat and politician serving as the Minister of External Affairs of the Government of India since 30 May 2019.
 
• The Indian Council for Cultural Relations is an autonomous organization of the Government of India, involved in India's global cultural relations, through cultural exchange with other countries and their people.
 
 
• President: Vinay Sahasrabuddhe

questions.question: In which state is the Onam festival celebrated?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Onam is the official festival of Kerala and is celebrated in the Malayalam calendar month of Chingam, which usually falls in August–September on the Gregorian calendar.
 
• The festival is a time of celebration and joy, and people reap the forest. 
 
• Few events are performed during Onam celebrations: Vallam Kali (boat races), Pulikali (tiger dances), Pookkalam (flower rangoli), Onathappan (worship), Onam Kali, Tug of War, Thumbi Thullal (women's dance), Kummattikali (mask dance), etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some festivals celebrated in Odisha, Punjab, and Tamil Nadu include:

 
• Durga Pooja
 
• A major festival in Odisha that is celebrated in September or October. 
 
• Baisakhi
 
• A major festival for the Punjabi community and Sikhs that celebrates the start of the rabi crop harvest season. It is also the Indian Solar New Year in many parts of India. 
 
• Pongal
 
• A four-day harvest festival celebrated in Tamil Nadu in mid-January. It honors the Sun God for a bountiful harvest. 
 
• Basant Panchami
 
• A Hindu spring harvest festival dedicated to the Hindu Goddess Saraswati. It is celebrated in January or February. 
 
• Makar Sankranti
 
• A Hindu festival celebrated in January in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and other parts of India. 
 
• Bhogi
 
• The first day of Pongal, which is celebrated to honor Lord Indra. A popular custom on this day is to burn useless items in a bonfire.

questions.question: Tulip festival is related to which of the following state/UTs?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu & Kashmir**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Tulip Festival is an annual celebration that aims to showcase the range of flowers in the garden as a part of tourism efforts by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It is the largest tulip garden in Asia spread over an area of about 30 hectares. It is situated on the foothills of Zabarwan Range with an overview of Dal Lake.
 
• The tulip garden was opened in 2007 with the aim of boosting floriculture and tourism in the Kashmir Valley by then Chief Minister Ghulam Nabi Azad.
 
• The garden is built on sloping ground in a terraced fashion consisting of seven terraces.
 
• Apart from tulips, many other species of flowers like hyacinths, daffodils, and ranunculus can be spotted here.
